profile.description: The profile object to use, including name, prompts, and examples

minecraft_version.description: The version of Minecraft to use. Set to 'auto' to automatically detect the version.

host.description: The minecraft server host address to connect to

port.description: The minecraft server port to connect to. -1 for auto-detect.

base_profile.description: Allowed values: survival, assistant, creative, god_mode. Each has fine tuned settings for different game modes.

load_memory.description: Whether to load bot's previous memory

world_memory.description: Whether to keep memory and saved places separately for each world the bot joins. Worlds are recognized by their seed. Off keeps one memory per bot

world_id.description: Fixed name for the current world that overrides the automatic world detection when world_memory is on. Empty to detect the world automatically

resume_goal.description: When to resume a goal loaded from memory: "always", "after_crash" (only after an automatic restart), or "never"

goal_resume_limit.description: Stop a loaded goal instead of resuming it when it was already resumed this many times within 15 minutes. 0 for no limit

init_message.description: The initial message to send to the bot
init_message.default: Respond with hello world and your name

only_chat_with.description: List of agents to only chat with. If empty, the bot will chat publicly

speak.description: Whether to enable text-to-speech reading on the host machine

language.description: The language to automatically translate to and from using google translate

blocked_actions.description: List of actions that are blocked

relevant_docs_count.description: Number of relevant function documents to include in the prompt for LLM code writing

max_messages.description: Maximum number of recent messages to keep in context for LLM

num_examples.description: Number of examples to select to help prompt better LLM responses

max_commands.description: Maximum number of commands allowed in consecutive responses. -1 for no limit

narrate_behavior.description: Whether to openly chat automatic behavior like 'Picking up item!'

log_all_prompts.description: Whether to log all prompts to file. Can be very verbose.

show_command_syntax.description: Whether to show "full" command syntax, "shortened" command syntax, or "none"

chat_ingame.description: Whether to show bot's chat messages in game chat

chat_bot_messages.description: Whether to publicly chat messages to and from other bots

render_bot_view.description: Whether to render bot view for user observation. Does not give bot vision.

allow_insecure_coding.description: Whether to allow newAction command that let's LLM write/run code on host computer. Despite sandboxxing, it is potentially insecure.

sandbox_lockdown.description: Whether to run the SES lockdown that isolates code written by the LLM from the host process when allow_insecure_coding is on. Set false only if a library breaks.

skill_learning.description: Whether to save code that worked as named skills in bots/<name>/skills, so later code can call them as customSkills.<name>. Needs allow_insecure_coding. Off keeps the behaviour without skills

skill_capture.description: With skill_learning on: whether to review code that worked and save it as a skill when it is general

skill_reuse.description: With skill_learning on: whether to show the saved skills to the model and let its code call them

skill_command.description: With skill_learning and skill_reuse on: whether to offer the !useSkill command that runs a saved skill directly

skill_max_count.description: With skill_learning on: the most skills the library keeps. Code of a new skill is not saved when the library is full, a new version of a saved skill always is. 0 for no limit

skill_disable_after_errors.description: With skill_learning on: switch a saved skill off after it threw an error this many times in a row. 0 to never switch a skill off

cost_meter.description: Whether to count the tokens and dollars of every call to the model, print the cost in the console, save it in bots/<name>/usage.json and answer !cost

cost_report_minutes.description: With cost_meter on: print the cost of the session every this many minutes. 0 for never

cost_warn_per_hour.description: With cost_meter on: warn in chat when the cost reaches this many dollars per hour. 0 for no warning

cost_limit_per_hour.description: With cost_meter on: stop working on goals and writing new code at this many dollars per hour, until the rate drops. Chat and commands still work. 0 for no limit

cost_limit_per_session.description: With cost_meter on: stop working on goals and writing new code for the rest of the session at this many dollars. Chat and commands still work. 0 for no limit

model_prices.description: With cost_meter on: dollars per million tokens for models without a built-in price, e.g. {"my-model": {"input": 1, "output": 5}}

max_command_result_chars.description: Shorten a command result in the chat history to this many characters, keeping its start and end. 0 for no limit

protected_areas.description: Whether the bot keeps saved buildings intact and only plants and harvests in saved farms, with !rememberArea and the other area commands. Needs world_memory

player_rules.description: Whether to save lasting rules of the players with !rememberRule and put them into every prompt

rules_max.description: With player_rules on: the most rules the bot keeps. 0 for no limit

home_pack.description: Whether to offer !goToShelter, !eat and a better !goToBed, and to run the reflexes of home_reflexes

home_reflexes.description: With home_pack on: which reflexes run. door_closing closes doors behind the bot, night_shelter goes to the shelter at night, creeper_safety leads creepers away from the base, hunger eats and fetches food from a known chest

creeper_fighting.description: With home_pack on: whether to fight a creeper that was led away from the base instead of running from it

storage_pack.description: Whether to offer !storeItems, !fetchItem and !chests, and to remember what is in the chests the bot opens

farming_pack.description: Whether to offer !farmCycle, !harvest, !plant, !makeBoneMeal and !fertilize, and to harvest and plant again when !collectBlocks names a crop

wood_pack.description: Whether to offer !chopTrees, !getTool and !craftSupplies, and to cut whole trees when !collectBlocks names a log

mining_pack.description: Whether to offer !mineOre, !goToMine and !leaveMine, and to go mining when !collectBlocks names an ore that is not in sight

mining_max_minutes.description: With mining_pack on: the longest time of one mining trip in minutes

keep_items.description: Items the bot keeps when it stores into chests, with the count to keep, -1 for all, e.g. {"wheat_seeds": 32}

stuck_restart_after.description: Failed escapes of the unstuck reflex in a row before the process restarts. 1 is the behaviour of v0.1.4.7: the process restarts when the first escape runs out of time. 0 for never: the bot gives up the escape and tells the model where it is stuck

protect_built_blocks.description: Whether the bot never breaks blocks that players build with (fences, doors, planks, beds ...), also outside the saved areas. A command that the player types in the chat may still do it

knowledge_in_prompt.description: Whether to put what the bot knows (where it is, the chests and what is in them, the areas, the mines, the places) into the chat prompt, so the model need not look again

knowledge_max_chars.description: With knowledge_in_prompt on: the longest the block of what the bot knows may be, in characters. The nearest chests are kept first

repeat_guard.description: Refuse the Nth try in a row of a command of the model that gave the same result each time, and tell the model to ask the player. Commands that the player types are never refused. 0 for off

restart_context.description: Whether to tell the model after a restart what the player had ordered, why the process ended and where the bot is. Saved in bots/<name>/last_exit.json

say_results.description: Whether to say the text of a work skill in the chat when the model answers nothing after it

flee_below_health.description: Below this health (0 to 20) the bot does not fight, it retreats to a player or the shelter. 0 for off

log_timestamps.description: Whether to print the time [HH:MM:SS] before each line of the console

examples_by_last_request.description: Whether the prompt examples are chosen by the last request of the player instead of the whole conversation

routes_pack.description: Whether to record the trail of the bot and offer !rememberRoute, !routes and !forgetRoute. !goToBed, the walk to the shelter and !goToRememberedPlace then use a way the player showed when the path search finds none

trail_max_steps.description: With routes_pack on: the steps of the trail that are kept, a whole number of 50 or more. The trail is saved in trail.json of the world

mine_routes.description: With mining_pack and routes_pack on: whether to offer !rememberMine, !rememberTunnel and !collectPassedOre, to work in the mine of the player along its way, to dig side branches and to list the ore left behind. Without routes_pack it stays off

ore_sense_range.description: 0 or 3. 0: in a tunnel the bot takes only ore that touches it, and !collectBlocks takes only ore with a face in the open. 3: also ore within 3 blocks of the wall

skills_over_code.description: Whether !newAction refuses to write code for a request about digging and names the commands that do it. A !newAction that the player types still runs

job_memory.description: Whether the bot keeps its job (mining, farming, cutting wood ...) in bots/<name>/job.json and comes back to it after an errand or a restart. When a skill lacks something (torches, a pickaxe) the model plans the steps, at most 3 times per job. Also needed for idle_jobs

job_resume_seconds.description: With job_memory on: the seconds without an order and with nothing running before the bot goes back to its job, a whole number of 10 or more

idle_jobs.description: With job_memory on: commands the bot runs in order when it has no job, a list of texts, e.g. ["!farmCycle(\"farm\")", "!craftSupplies(\"torch\", 32)"]. Empty for none

idle_jobs_minutes.description: With job_memory on: an entry of idle_jobs runs at most once per this many minutes, a whole number of 1 or more

area_floors.description: Whether !rememberArea in a building with floors saves only the floor the bot stands on, so the house and the basement are two areas. A trapdoor or a ladder between the floors is a wall of the scan

mine_from_inside.description: Whether a new shaft may start from the room or a tunnel of a known mine, when an ore lies deeper (a second level of the mine with ladders, listed under its mine). Off: a new mine starts from the surface only

routes_by_search.description: With routes_pack on: whether a route is walked by the path search from waypoint to waypoint (its ends, doors, gates, trapdoors and ladder ends), joined at the nearest waypoint, after a dry scan that names what blocks the way before the first step. Off: the route is walked leg by leg

area_sense.description: Whether the bot scans an unsaved enclosure it enters and says what it thinks it is (a pen, a farm, a home), once per enclosure. Needs protected_areas

smelting.description: Whether !smeltItem uses the storage pack: a furnace in a saved room, the fuel it needs, a batch of up to 64, the result read from the furnace; and whether a plan may smelt raw iron for an iron tool. Off: !smeltItem of the original project

watch_server.description: Whether the watch server runs: a Claude session reads the state, the inventory, the chat, the places and the events of the bot and can say a line, over MCP on 127.0.0.1:watch_port. Starts only with MC_WATCH_TOKEN in the environment

watch_port.description: The port of the watch server, on 127.0.0.1 only. Needs watch_server

watch_and_learn.description: Whether the bot learns by watching: !watchMe records the blocks the player places or breaks, !continueLike says the pattern it understood (a line, a fence with a gate, a tunnel) and !buildWatched builds or digs the rest after the player's yes

other_bots.description: The names of the owner's other bots. The bot never answers their chat, and never answers a command echo (*x used y*) or a result of a bot, whoever sent it. Empty: the bot answers every player

bot_role.description: One sentence of the bot's role in the conversation prompt, e.g. 'You are the farmer. gpt is the miner.' Empty: no role line

voice_ui.description: Whether the page of the mindserver has the live voice: whisper hears the owner, Supertonic speaks the bot's lines in the page, the system voice is silent. Read when the mindserver starts; needs npm run voice:setup (about 1.6 GB)

voice_voice.description: With voice_ui: the voice of the bot in the page, supertonic:F1 to F5 or M1 to M5; kokoro:af_heart needs kokoro-js

voice_language.description: With voice_ui: the language whisper hears ('auto' for any) and Supertonic speaks (English when it does not speak it)

watch_local_only.description: With watch_server: the server answers this machine only and needs no token; a request through a tunnel is refused. Off: the token of MC_WATCH_TOKEN, for a session elsewhere

watch_report_seconds.description: With watch_server: every N seconds an event 'report' with the digest since the last report, even when nothing happened. 0: no report

mine_other_ores.description: With mining_pack: while the bot mines one ore, the other ores it takes from the tunnel's walls, floor and ceiling are counted in its text ('and 11 redstone and 4 lapis_lazuli on the way'). Off: the text names only the ore asked for

supervisor_name.description: The name the owner addresses the supervisor by ('Opus, why is it going up?'): such a line is an event 'message' of the watch server and no bot answers it; the supervisor's lines come back as '[Opus] ...'. Empty: no supervisor in the chat, no help or message events, no notes

supervisor_voice.description: With voice_ui: the voice the page gives the supervisor's lines, supertonic:F1 to F5 or M1 to M5

supervisor_updates.description: Whether the supervisor's unprompted updates ('[Opus] The mining is at 2 of 6.') are shown and spoken. Off: only its answers to lines that named it

shared_memory.description: With world_memory: the areas, places, routes, mines, chests and rules of a world live in bots/shared/worlds/<seed>/ and every bot reads and writes them. The chat memory and the job stay per bot. Off: each bot has its own memory

prompt_cache.description: Whether the prompt is sent in two parts: the fixed part first (the introduction, the command list), then what changes (memory, stats, inventory, knowledge, examples). On the Anthropic API the fixed part carries a cache mark. Off: the prompt as before

code_timeout_mins.description: Number of minutes to allow code execution. -1 for no timeout

task.description: The task object to give the agent on start. If null, the agent will not have a task.

spawn_timeout.description: Number of seconds allowed for the bot to spawn before throwing an error. Increase when spawning takes a while.
